name: obsidian-ai-agent-panel
description: Unofficial Obsidian plugin that brings an AI coding agent into your vault as a native chat panel. First integration: Anthropic's Claude Code CLI.

scripts.pretest: esbuild src/diff.ts src/edits.ts src/bash.ts src/cli.ts src/checkpoints.ts src/mcp/server.ts src/mcp/query.ts src/protocol/client.ts src/settings-core.ts src/models.ts src/tabs-layout.ts src/conversation-list.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outbase=src --out-extension:.js=.mjs --log-level=warning --outdir=tests/.build
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json

author: Yoav Aharoni
